summary.text: Tom Andersen is a state representative from Oregon House District 19 who took office in January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election on the Democratic, Working Families and Independent Party of Oregon lines.
Ballotpedia lists Anna Munson as his general-election opponent.

paragraphs.text: Andersen was born in Chicago, lives in Salem, and earned a J.D. from the University of Oregon School of Law in 1976.
He worked as an attorney, including as a trial lawyer for the State Accident Insurance Fund Corporation (SAIF) and in private practice.
Andersen served on the Salem City Council representing Ward 2 from 2019 to 2022.
He assumed office in the Oregon House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Raquel Moore-Green.
For 2023-2024, Ballotpedia lists him as vice chair of the Judiciary Committee and a member of the House Energy and Environment and Early Childhood committees.
